input.subject: Dripping basin tap – 3 Kestrel Close (ref R/2)
input.body:
Hello,

I'm sorry nobody has been in touch about the bathroom basin tap at 3 Kestrel Close (ref R/2). Our booking request to the plumber did not go through and our update to you also failed to send. Your landlord has agreed to a plumber visit, and we are now contacting Brightwell Plumbing directly to get someone booked as a priority.

In the meantime, to stop the puddle growing:
- Look under the basin for the small isolation valve on the pipe feeding the tap. Turn the screw slot a quarter turn with a flat screwdriver so it sits across the pipe; this should stop the drip. If there's no isolation valve, the main stopcock (often under the kitchen sink) will turn off the water.
- Mop up the water and put a towel or bowl underneath to catch any more.
- If water reaches light fittings, sockets or the ceiling below, keep clear of electrics and call us straight away.

We will update you by tomorrow, 5 October, with who is attending. Please let us know if anything gets worse before then.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team
